source.title: Observation of second sound in graphite at temperatures above 100 K
source.authors: Samuel Huberman, Ryan A. Duncan, Ke Chen, Bai Song, Vazrik Chiloyan, Zhiwei Ding, Alexei A. Maznev, Gang Chen, Keith A. Nelson
source.license_or_terms: Open arXiv preprint; redistribution terms for a local raw copy were not assumed
source_locators: Supplementary Materials pp. 3-5, Eqs. S1-S7: linearized PBTE, modal heat capacity, and TTG response
Supplementary Materials p. 2: room-temperature and low-temperature pump/probe energy ranges
Supplementary Materials p. 3: estimated temperature amplitudes and thermal diffusion correction
Supplementary Materials p. 6: HOPG Grade 1 sample and grain-size characterization

source_state.response_regime: one-dimensional TTG Green-function solution of the linearized PBTE with a full scattering matrix
source_state.isotope_and_defect_state: isotope scattering included in the method; a complete specimen-state payload is not public in this route

formula_records.canonical_notation: partial_t g_i + v_i dot grad g_i = Q p_i + sum_j W_ij(g_j^0 - g_j)
formula_records.units: g_i is deviational energy density; source-specific SI units

formula_records.canonical_notation: Delta_T_tilde = sum_i(g_i_tilde) / C; C = sum_i c_i
formula_records.units: Delta_T in K; C in source-defined heat-capacity units
thermal conductivity units after source SI conversion

acceptance_boundary.acceptance_reason: The public route contains equations and setup estimates but not row-complete mode data, force constants, response traces, or a paired base-Phi amplitude.

ontology.C: collective system-behaviour coordinate; not heat capacity or mass
ontology.Phi: effective response variable; no identity with g_i or temperature is asserted
ontology.R_gen: derived physical/history trace; no independent state or backreaction
ontology.R_obs: observer record separate from PBTE dynamics

claim_boundary: This package closes only a public formula/setup source boundary. It does not provide C_src, a Ding-equivalent reproduction, an independent alpha_Phi_K, a base-Phi SI anchor, or Full Topic 13 closure.
